categories.main_business_segments: The company operates primarily in two segments: fluorine-containing new materials and polyurethane new materials. The fluorine segment includes production and sales of fluorine refrigerants, fluoropolymers such as PVDF, and fine fluorine chemicals. The polyurethane segment focuses on the research, production, and sales of polyurethane products including polyether polyols and polyester polyols, mainly for insulation and other industrial applications.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced chemical synthesis and polymerization technologies for fluorine-containing materials, including industrial-scale production of HCFC-142b, HFC-152a, PVDF, and fourth-generation low-GWP refrigerants (HFOs). It employs proprietary catalytic processes, heat recovery systems, and automated DCS control systems to enhance efficiency and product quality. In polyurethane production, it uses high-temperature polymerization and customized formulation technologies to produce differentiated polyether and polyester polyols with specific performance characteristics.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include manufacturers in the lithium battery, photovoltaic, semiconductor, refrigeration, construction, automotive, and household appliance industries. The fluorine materials serve strategic emerging sectors such as new energy batteries, electronics, and aerospace. The polyurethane products are widely used in insulation for refrigerators, cold chain logistics, building materials, and automotive sectors. The company also exports to markets in Europe, America, and Asia.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in China with production bases in Shandong Province (Zibo) and Inner Mongolia (Wuhai). It serves domestic markets predominantly but also has significant export sales accounting for approximately 19.46% of revenue, targeting international markets including Europe, America, and Southeast Asia.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates an integrated upstream to midstream position in the chemical supply chain. It produces key raw materials such as HCFC-142b and HFC-152a used internally for downstream fluoropolymers like PVDF, enabling vertical integration. It also manufactures intermediate and final products such as refrigerants and polyurethane polyols, supplying downstream manufacturers in various industries.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include expanding production capacity for fourth-generation environmentally friendly refrigerants and fluoropolymers, developing solid-state lithium battery materials, and advancing green and low-carbon chemical processes. The company emphasizes R&D collaboration with universities, notably the joint carbon-neutral technology research institute with Sun Yat-sen University, focusing on carbon neutrality, solid-state electrolytes, and polymer materials. It also invests in bio-based polyurethane development and continuous process innovation to improve product quality and environmental compliance.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through product sales of chemical materials including fluorine refrigerants, fluoropolymers, and polyurethane raw materials. Sales are conducted via direct contracts with industrial customers domestically and internationally. The company does not rely on subscription or licensing models but focuses on manufacturing and selling chemical products.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is positioned as a leading domestic integrated fluorochemical and polyurethane materials producer with early mover advantages in fourth-generation refrigerants and lithium battery materials. It competes with other major Chinese fluorochemical producers and international chemical companies in high-value fluoropolymers and refrigerants. Its vertical integration and proprietary technologies provide competitive cost and quality advantages.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenue of approximately RMB 868.7 million, a 16.11% decrease from the previous year, with net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 21.86 million, a 71.94% increase. The fluorine materials segment accounted for 71.34% of revenue, and polyurethane 28.66%. The company has a total asset base of about RMB 2.55 billion and equity of RMB 1.96 billion. Despite revenue decline due to market conditions, profitability improved, supported by cost control and R&D-driven product upgrades.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes its integrated production platform, proprietary technologies, and early deployment in environmentally friendly fourth-generation refrigerants and high-performance fluoropolymers like PVDF. Its products offer superior chemical resistance, environmental compliance, and application versatility in strategic emerging industries such as new energy batteries and green refrigeration. The company’s ability to leverage vertical integration reduces costs and ensures stable raw material supply, while its strong R&D capabilities enable continuous innovation and customized solutions for diverse customer needs.
